kind_why: A combat surf map: small, built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: Buck Nasty

attribution.author: Buck Nasty
attribution.source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/121524 (published as surf_10x_reloaded_fix; Key Authors: Buck Nasty; submitter BuckNasty)

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): a combat surf map with no finish -- two buyzones, 100-odd weapons on the floor, jail1/jail2/jailbreak destinations and a middle sniper perch. Every trigger_teleport aims back at a spawn, a jail or the top of a ramp, so there is a loop to fight on and no line a run could end at. Not published.
